title: Power Update After K-th Largest Insertion I
summary: For each [value,k] query, insert value into nums, take the kth largest current element x, and update p to p^x modulo 1000000007. Return successive p values. This variant promises a difference below ten between consecutive k values; confirm whether that bound is absolute before exploiting it.
